cases.mechanism: tighten() calls _val(n). _arith tokenizes with `re.findall(r'\d+...|[-+*/()^]')` and requires `''.join(toks) == s`. That check fails on '\sqrt', so _val returns None. _near_miss then looks only at the literal 1536.6400235, which is nowhere near 39.2, so the original reward is kept. math_verify evaluates sqrt(Float 1536.6400235) = 39.2000003 and compares numbers after rounding to 6 decimals (float_rounding). That gives 39.2, so verify returns True.
cases.why_incorrect: sqrt(1536.6400235) is about 39.2000003, not exactly 39.2. The verifier cannot match '\sqrt{1536.6400235}' to 39.2 by string or exact numeric equality.
